title: Resounding Shackle
content:
# Resounding Shackle

Internal ID: TrinketScaleStaminaDamage | Type: Trinkets | Source: Black forge | Crafting Materials: Refined eitr x5, Scale hide x5, Mandible x1, Seeker trophy x1 | Adrenaline Cost: 75 | Effect: 100 stamina gain | +10% Slash | Duration: 1m

# Introduction

Resounding Shackle is a Mistlands-tier trinket.

## Effects

Once 75 Adrenaline has been gained, the Resounding Shackle will trigger automatically, providing 100 stamina immediately, and +10% slash damage for 60 seconds.

Categorias: Trinket
